notes.title: Bring a friend and get prizes together!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43094954/b74652c16f7c3afe79237b494b7e2e54fed00928.png[/img]
Dominators! 

In addition to changes in balance, heroes and artifacts, there's something completely new waiting for you in the game.

[h2]Bring a friend and get prizes together![/h2] 

Now you can call your friends to dominate the map together and get nice rewards. 

To call a friend you need to:
- go to your friends list;
- choose a referral program item;
- copy the code and give it to your friend.

When you create a player profile, your friend can enter the code and get rewards!
for each friend you invite to the game you get 200 game currency, and your friend 400;
when your friend reaches level 3, 5 or 10 he or she will get 200 game currency, and you will get 100 game currency.

[h2]Promo codes [/h2]

We also added the functionality of promo codes to the game. 

To enter a promo code:

- open your inventory;
- in the inventory, go to the "Promo Code" tab;
- enter a promo code and receive rewards.

For players with "Dominator" status, we prepared a separate surprise - promo codes that will allow you to get one of the dominator skins. Take one from the list: 

[i]DominatorFinn
DominatorVeteran
DominatorDanila
DominatorValkyrie
DominatorStalker
DominatorHunter[/i]

Enter and get a skin for your favorite hero. 

[b]Important[/b]: a promo code can only be used on one hero. A different promo code from the list will not work if you use and get a skin. 
Look at the skins already in the game, to choose and decide.
The skin is only available for players with the rank of [b]Dominator[/b].

notes.title: 0.1.244 hotfix
A snowstorm of content is already in the game!
notes.content:
The meteorologists warned us of an impending snowstorm... and here it is! A new seeker has arrived in Dominance and has brought many new things!

New patch 0.12.

[h2][b]New seeker: Danila.[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43094954/6f3445ce127018d866a0d3387ddfc95b4be6a9e9.png[/img]

Danila is a former mountaineer who lost both legs in an accident. It seemed like his life was over until a mysterious scientist approached him with an offer he couldn't refuse. After a successful test, Danila received an exoskeleton, and with it, the ability to walk. He is more determined than ever to return to the top of the world - because that is where he belongs. 

[h2][b]Seeker characteristics:[/b][/h2]

Hook:
Danila throws his climbing hook.
Once he hits an enemy or ally, he draws him to himself.
Using the hook, Danila can be attracted to walls and objects on the map.
When Danila throws his hook against a wall, he makes an ice tunnel and can pass through the walls.


Perks:
Climbing Skills:
Hitting enemies or an obstacle causes the hook's cooldown speed to decrease.
Ice Tunnel does not reduce the cooldown speed of the ability. A hook that hits an enemy stuns it.

Supply:
Taking damage, Danila scatters canned goods around him. Canned food can be picked up by any player. Canned food restores life points over time.

Improved exoskeleton:
Danila increases his health and gains a bonus to recharge abilities.

Improved backpack:
Danila increases the number of inventory slots and the number of artifact slots.

Environmental adaptation:
Danila increases the clip size and marksmanship of all allies and reduces all damage they take from fighting monsters.

[h2][b]Altars rework.[/b][/h2]

At the beginning of the game all altars are neutral. To capture an altar and receive bonuses, you must stand in its area. The number of players in the area does not affect  the time of capture. 

The team that captures the altar receives the following bonuses: 

1. All players on the team, regardless of where they are on the map, receive experience points once every 3 seconds. The more altars a team captures, the more experience they receive. After capturing 3 altars, each next altar gives less experience points to the team. The maximum number of captured altars with bonuses is 5. 

2. Once captured, the altar scans the area in which it is located, highlighting the players of the hostile team and chests with loot. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43094954/e6b38fff4d10067573e49a74965e50e02d605c4c.png[/img]

3. Players of the hostile team will take damage from the altar. The altar takes a percentage of the maximum amount of the enemy team's strength. The damage of the altar is divided between the targets, but not divided by more than 3 targets.
A captured altar illuminates invisible enemies in its area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43094954/d9b9511aedf5566705c19eca5a3b54134105e07d.png[/img]

4. To capture an altar, you must enter its area, but if at least one member of the team to which it belongs is there - capture is impossible. Players in a knockdown do not interfere with the capture. The altar does not deal damage or illuminate enemies for the duration of the recapture.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43094954/7f04b4312e2de80d0f23d83f4358de6e62587c9f.png[/img]

[h2][b]Altar no longer:[/b][/h2]
-Does not restore shields;
-Does not help you  get up from the knockdown faster;
-Does not revive.

[h2][b]Obelisks: A new element on the map.[/b][/h2]

Players in each area can now encounter obelisks on their path. Near the obelisk, its energy restores life points and shields. The energy of the obelisk is limited, and you need time to regenerate it. You can also revive near the obelisk and get back up faster from knockdown. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43094954/abfe57a7c94b3958add51e580ec8e4544d6c7759.png[/img]

[h2][b]Ascension: a new way to improve your heroes.[/b] [/h2]
Added into the game, but not yet available.

A new section has now been added to the lobby. With the leveling of the profile players get points, which can now be spent in the climbing section and invested in passive skills. 
Climbing is unique and available to every seeker. What a player invests in climbing can be used in a match. The player can choose up to 3 skills from the general page and up to 3 from the seeker page. 

Number of points depending on level: 
2-10 levels: 3 points per level;
11-20 levels: 2 points per level;
Level 21 and beyond: 1 point per level.

Now's the time to dominate the map!

notes.title: Patch 0.10
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43094954/b9efefcdeabeff2d1d768af9a846984cfea3fe14.png[/img]

Version v0.10 of Dominance is available on the servers.

[b]Gameplay[/b]

The weapon is now upgraded from causing damage. To raise the level of the weapon, you must cause:
- gray grade - green grade: 4000 damage
- green grade - blue grade: 8000 damage
- blue grade - purple grade: 12,000 damage

Weapons cannot be upgraded to the golden grade with the damage nor by finding its copies.

Weapons gain experience when dealing damage to players, bosses and air drops.
The weapon can still be upgraded by finding a copy. In this case, the experience gained with the damage is saved at a new weapon level.

[b]Balance[/b]

Usage of following items is changed: bandages, pills, adrenaline, first aid kit. Seeker Valkyrie got changes too.

Bandages, pills, adrenaline: 

- Time of effects is reduced to 20 seconds at all levels;
- Cooldown is now 40 seconds on all levels.

First aid kit:

- Cooldown is changed to 20 seconds on all levels.

Valkyrie:

- Shield growth per level is reduced from 40 to 30;
Perk "Fortification":
- Pre-recovery pause is standardized from 6/5/3 to 4 seconds at all levels;
- Shield recovery strength is changed from 20/40/60 to 30/40/50.

[b]Bug fixes[/b]

The following bugs were fixed: 
- damage that lead to a huge recovery of the Veteran’s health;
- which made the downed player invulnerable for a while;
- which caused clothed customization to disappear;
- which caused the bots to see invisible players;
- which caused the speed of the characters to change incorrectly.

[b]System[/b]

A large quantity of gaming services was optimized.

Have a good game!

notes.title: Update v 0.1.235 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Greetings, Dominators! Dominance v 0.1.235 is here — read about all the changes in this post and also about our plans for the enarest future!

[h3]Training grounds[/h3]
In this patch  we wanted to present the players with the basis for our Training grounds: you can go there by clicking the button above “Play”. You will be instantly moved to the polygon .
This version of Training grounds has:
[list]
[*] Seeker selection available at any moment
[*] Weapons, armor and artefacts lying around the map, in addition to the drops from normal chests.
[*] The whole map open for exploration and the zone not shrinking
[*] Up to 27 players present on one polygon
[*] Player damage to each other disabled
[/list]
In the future (February - mid March) Training grounds will recieve:
[list]
[*] Special zones in each map are where gear is constantly respawned
[*] This areas will also have test dummies with 4 levels of defense: 0, 25%, 50% and 75%.
[*] Ability to teleport around the map for easier exploration
[*] Bosses for each area, which respawn upon being killed
[/list]
We will monitor the feedback about the Training grounds and take into account your ideas to make it better.

[h3]Weapons[/h3]
[b]Pistol[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage lowered from 28 to 22 on all rarity levels
[/list]
[b]Butcher[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage lowered from 28/32/36/40/51 to 20/22/24/26/31
[/list]
[b]Revolver[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage lowered from 40/46/52/58/78 to 40/44/48/52/61
[/list]
[b]Blaster[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage lowered from 4/6/8/10/13 to 3/5/7/9/12
[/list]
[b]Shotbow[/b]
[list]
[*] Base damage lowered from 72 to 54. 
[*] Damage per arrow from alt ability lowered from 72 to 54
[/list]
[b]Shotgun [/b]
[list]
[*] Damage per pellet lowered from 27/31/35/39/39 to 22/25/28/31/36 
[/list]
[b]Overkill[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage per pellet lowered from 7/7/7/7/11 to 5/5/5/5/8
[/list]
[b]Pulsegun[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage lowered from 26/36/44/56/68 to 28/32/36/40/48
[/list]
[b]Flack canon[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage lowered from 45 to 33 on all rarity levels
[*] Projectile speed lowered from 2250 to 2050 on all rarity levels
[/list]
[b]Earthquake[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage lowered from  170/210/250/290/390 to 170/200/230/260/320 in the middle of the blast zone 
[*] Blast zone radius lowered by 15%
[/list]
[b]Beamgun[/b]
[list]
[*] Beam turn speed lowered from 30/30/30/30/40 to 25 on all rarity levels
[/list]

In the upcoming patches we’ll also take a stab at Seeker balance, artefacts, armor and consumables.

[h3]Interface[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added mouse sensitivity setting
[*] Sensitivity can be set anywhere inbetween 0.1 to infinity and beyond
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Localization fixes
[*] Fixed a bug, which caused the game client to crash in situation where the “Play” button would become unavailable after adding players to your group
[*] Added technical logs display when the servers are unavailable
[*] Fixed the Beambun’s laser collision box
[/list]

[h3]Nearest future plans (this February)[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Weapons will get the ability to level up by dealing damage[/b]
We want to lower the impact of luck and random on the player’s ability to get good gear for the late-game. By dealing damage any weapon will accumulate experience, which can level up it to a higher rarity. Damage dealt will be counted both to other players and the bosses 
[*] [b]Weapons will be tied to map areas[/b]
To accompany the previous change, we also want to tie different weapons to different areas of the map. Hopefully this will lower the randomness of acquiring the gear even more, and help the players to build their Seekers more consistently.
[/list]

notes.title: Open Beta is Here — play Dominance NOW!
notes.content:
The time has come, dominators!

Dominance has entered Open Beta phase and is available to absolutely everyone! No more restrictions — Dominance is free to play, and available to play at any time from now on! 

[previewyoutube=Qc671e7KL90;full][/previewyoutube]
Experience the world’s first bullet-hell royale today — enter the battle as one of the Seekers, сreate various character builds, and dominate the battlefield! 

[quote]NOTE: If you have Dominance Playtest installed — please visit [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2175780/Dominance/]the game's Steam page[/url] and install the main client.[/quote]
With Open Beta we’re also launching the Alpha Season, during which you can earn and unlock unique skins for Seekers and weapons, emotions, stickers and more through the Battle Pass. We plan to add new unique content each season — from brand new Seekers, to skins and even new gameplay mechanics!

And as [b]thanks to everyone who participated[/b] in our playtests earlier we're gifting a free Battle Pass for the Alpha Season!

[h3]What is Dominance?[/h3]
Dominance is an absolutely new team based multiplayer top-down shooter. What makes this game so unique is the unusual combination of Bullet-Hell and Battle Royale genres as well as the plot itself taking its place in alternative 80's where humanity is experimenting with aliens' technologies. 

Before the start of the match, each player chooses one of the five most suitable characters.There’re 27 players in total who can either survive or die based on how wisely they use the hero abilities and weapons, as well as dodge the shots of enemies.  

The main principle of Dominance is "The less limitations, the better”. The battlefield is turning into a huge field for experiments with character builds, weapons, and play styles providing a unique experience for the players.  

Here are the main features of the game: 
[list]
[*][b]Bullet Hell Royale[/b]
Take out enemies with precise hits, predict their movement to come out on top, and utilize active skills, unique to each weapon type and character, to truly Dominate the battlefield. 
[*][b]Limitless Build Variety[/b]
Evolve your character and equipment. Explore the synergies and combinations of abilities, artifacts, guns and armor to find the one that perfectly compliments your style of play. 
[*][b]A living breathing map [/b]
The battlefield changes as you play. The world of Dominance plays an equally important role during battle – pay attention to your surroundings to stay ahead! Every area has its unique bonuses and hazards. Use the terrain to your advantage – hide in bushes to ambush your opponents, run on concrete to move faster, and explore other unique properties of the game map! 
[*][b]A roster of characters [/b]
Choose your alter ego from five heroes. Perhaps an alien invisible lizard or a super-mobile guy with teleportation would work for you? Each character has their own unique set of active and passive abilities, as well as their own leveling tree.
[*][b]Integration with the Steam Marketplace[/b]
An advanced economy is available from the beginning of the Open Beta Test. You can put any item in the game on the trading floor, including items earned through a Battle Pass. Collect, accumulate, and trade in outfits, emotes, and other customization items.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2175780/Dominance/

[h3]Influence the development[/h3]
Our goal is to create a highly engaging and unique experience, a new word in the genre of battle royale. And to achieve this we’ll need your feedback. Share your impressions from the game, ideas and suggestions — we will read every single one of them and promise that you will be heard! 

[quote][h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2175780/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url][/h3][/quote]
[quote][h3][url=https://discord.gg/Vcv4ynjVZE]Official Discord[/url][/h3][/quote]
[quote][h3][url=https://forms.gle/Sj4dB6dHSo943Dx58]Feedback Form[/url][/h3][/quote]

Open Beta is only the beginning for us and Dominance — we’re already working on multiple new Seekers, gameplay mechanics and general improvements. However, only together can we make Dominance the best it can be! 

Thank you for being interested in Dominance and see you on the battlefields!

[url=https://discord.gg/Vcv4ynjVZE][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43092025/c4873e6d7d54afaac3a971ec4a4ed420f9ecc51b.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: January 4-5 playtest!
notes.content:
Happy New Year, Dominators!

The New 2023 Year is here and on behalf of the team we wish you to be successful in every beginning, for trouble to steer away from you and your close ones and, of course, lots of good games!

As for us, we’re preparing to host another playtest on January 4-5. This playtest will again be focused on our existing community, but you definitely should bring your friends to try out the game!

This playtest will also, most probably, be the last one as we prepare to launch the Open Beta — which, as a reminder, wil start this January! Stay tuned for updates, as we will definitely post an announcement about the exact date of OBT and what to expect from it.

[h3]How to Play[/h3]
If you've [b]participated in the previous playtest[/b], or at least got access and downloaded the game —  [b]just update Dominance[/b] and jump into the game!

[b]If you're a new player[/b] — simply go to Dominance Steam page, click “Request Access”. After receiving confirmation press "Play the Game" to install the game’s client.

[b]There are no restrictions on when or how long to play[/b] — simply launch the game any time you want and play as long as you want[b] until January 5th at 11:00 pm PST[/b]! If there are not enough players in the match — the game will add bots for you to play against.

[h3]How to play with friends[/h3]
1. Open your Friend list and click “+Invites”.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43094954/23c5d67fb407a11aa26f89fe45038256a4c15fa8.png[/img]

2. Type in the nickname of the player you want to add. [b]IMPORTANT:[/b] Upon 1st launch the game will ask you to come up with a nickname — you have to write this nickname to add a friend and NOT their Steam nickname.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43094954/067958d27a5e26c193c9813c93ab0dbd83466e04.png[/img]

3. After your friend accepts the invitation, you can find them in your Friend list. Simply click on their profile in the list and select “Invite to Party”.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43094954/8f283e553ffbe7bdeea385ded93fefac4ff9423f.png[/img]

4. Voila! Just click “Play” and you’ll be on the same team when the match begins. You can have up to 3 people playing in one team.

[h3]Where do I report a bug or leave feedback?[/h3]
You can leave any feedback or bug reports here, if you'd like to share!
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2175780/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url]! We would appreciate any and all ideas and feedback.

[h3]Error 002 - Server is not responding[/h3]
This error means that the game’s server is currently offline. While we do our best to make sure it works properly throughout the playtest — some hiccups can still occur. [b]If you’re met with this error upon entering the game — just try starting it again a couple minutes later.[/b]

Happy New Year once again, and we’ll wait for you on the battlefields of Dominance!

notes.title: Dominance — Next Playtest on December 3-4!
notes.content:
Hello, Dominators!

The weekends are here, and so is the newest Dominance playtest — [b]starting Dec 3rd and until 11:00 pm PST Dec 4th[/b]! Join the battlefields and try out the first ever Bullet-hell Royale — solo or with friends!

Continuing our trend of making Dominance even better, we’ve introduced some big changes this patch. Our goal with the game is to make it the most explosively fun it can be!

Main changes in the latest version:
[list]
[*] [b]Changes to revive mechanics[/b] — you now have [i]unlimited [/i]revives in the early game!
[*] [b]Critical hits[/b] — attain a new level of power with this change!
[*] [b]New tier 5 rarity for all gear[/b] — limited in drop, but extremely powerful!
[*] Changes to stats for many characters and weapons!
[*] Visual updates for multiple areas of the map
[/list]
[b]Read full changelog, thoughts behind the changes and future plans below![/b] Let us know what you think of the game in Steam Discussions — your feedback is essential to us!
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2175780/discussions/][quote][h3]Leave Feedback[/h3][/quote][/url]

[h3]How to Play[/h3]
If you've [b]participated in previous playtest[/b], or at least got access and downloaded the game —  [b]just update Dominance[/b] and jump into the game!

[b]If you're a new player[/b] — simply go to Dominance Steam page, click “Request Access”. After receiving confirmation press "Play the Game" to install the game’s client.

[b]There are no restrictions on when or how long to play[/b] — simply launch the game any time you want and play as long as you want[b] until December 4th at 11:00 pm PST[/b]! If there are not enough players in the match — the game will add bots for you to play against.

[h3]How to play with friends[/h3]
1. Open your Friend list and click “+Invites”
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43094954/23c5d67fb407a11aa26f89fe45038256a4c15fa8.png[/img]

2. Type in the nickname of the player you want to add. [b]IMPORTANT:[/b] Upon 1st launch the game will ask you to come up with a nickname — you have to write this nickname to add a friend and NOT their Steam nickname.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43094954/067958d27a5e26c193c9813c93ab0dbd83466e04.png[/img]

3. After your friend accepts the invitation, you can find them in your Friend list. Simply click on their profile in the list and select “Invite to Party”
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43094954/8f283e553ffbe7bdeea385ded93fefac4ff9423f.png[/img]

4. Voila! Just click “Play” and you’ll be on the same team when the match begins. You can have up to 3 people playing on one team.

[h3]Where do I report a bug or leave feedback?[/h3]
You can leave any feedback or bug reports here, if you'd like to share!
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2175780/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url]! We would appreciate any and all ideas and feedback.

[h3]Error 002 - Server is not responding[/h3]
This error means that the game’s server is currently offline. While we do our best to make sure it works properly throughout the playtest — some hiccups can still occur. [b]If you’re met with this error upon entering the game — just try starting it again a couple minutes later.[/b]

[h2]Foreword[/h2]
During playtests we’ve outlined a problem with gameplay dynamics and our “risk-reward” systems. In simple terms — in the explosive gameplay we’ve created it’s very disheartening to die with a full build in mere seconds. 

To compensate the turbo speeds and unique features of our explosive gameplay we’ve decided  to split match time into 3 big phases — and give them with distinct conditions and bonuses. 

The first phase is going to take up to 40% of overall match time and lasts until 4th zone shrink. During this period we’re allowing players to die and respawn on shrines UNLIMITED amount of times. 

The second phase will feature our current rules — 1 chance to resurrect, after which you get eliminated upon dying again.

During the third phase — at the very end of a match — we’re fully disabling resurrections. Even if you didn’t die previously. In our opinion even right now you’d already have trouble finding a fitting shrine to resurrect, so this change shouldn’t be all that noticeable. But do share your thoughts on the matter!

From the balance perspective we’re going to make players considerably tougher, while providing new tools for dealing damage. Overall we think that right now it’s a bit too easy to get top damage, and we want full imba build to consist of more elements. 

Specifically speaking, we’re introducing “critical hit” stat, which will be based off your Aim stat. Our version of critical hit provides a chance to fully ignore enemy armor with Aim/2 chance. Critical hits will be displayed with a big juicy font, to maximize the amount of dopamine received. 

As for weapons overall, since we’re introducing critical hit we’ll have to cut base damage for all weapons — around 10-20%. Also, we’ll lower bonuses to Force and Aim from perks and items, to compensate just how utterly insane our critical hit turned out. 

We’ve also changed a bit how items drop from airdrops and chests. In short, we’ve added tier 5 rarity to items, which can be attained only through airdrops — and which can not be achieved by normally (when we stack gear copies to raise its level). This tier 5 rarity will provide substantial power boost and amount of such items on the map will be very limited.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]General gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now every player has unique random selection of gear to buy before deploying
[*] [b]Respawn phases mechanic.[/b]
[i]Green phase[/i] — early game. Lasts 3 zone shrinks: players can resurrect [b]unlimited [/b]amounts of times.
[i]Orange phase[/i] — mid game. Lasts another 3 zone shrinks: players can respawn only once. 
[i]Red phase[/i] — late game. Lasts 2 zone shrinks: players can not respawn if killed during the red phase.
[*] Changed the timer for first 3 zone shrinks from 120/100/90 to 90/80/70
[*] Added [b]“Critical hit”[/b] stat
Critical hits ignore 100% of target’s armor
Chance to deal a critical hit depends on Aim stat and calculates with Aim/2 formula.
[*] [b]Added tier 5 rarity to all consumables, weapons and armor[/b]
Tier 5 rarity is equal to level 4 rarity pre-patch
Tier 1 rarity items have the same stats as common items pre-patch
Power of every other rarity tier has been reworked to incorporate the 5-tier rarity system
Tier 5 rarity items only drop from airdrops, and can not be attained by other means
[*] Changed rarity tiers order: white, green, blue, purple, orange
[*] Airdrops now drop less rewards and experience, but exclusively drop tier 5 items
[*] Amount of loot in normal chests has been lowered
[/list]
[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Valkyrie[/b]
Perk “4” no longer grants armor penetration.
Now grants squad buff — all allies ignore set percent of target’s armor.
Buff from multiple Valkyries doesn't stack
Amount of armor ignored lowered to 10/15/25%.
[*] [b]Hunter[/b]
Hunter’s Boomerang no longer applies “blinded” to a target hit.
Upon hitting an enemy, makes them visible to Hunter and his allies. Target is visible on both the map and mini-map
Perks “1” and “2” are now also applied to the area around a target
Boomerang ignores Valkyrie’s Barrier bubble
[*] Power of artefacts granting bonuses to Force and Aim lowered to compensate for the damage from critical hits
[*] Power of character perks granting bonuses to Force and Aim lowered to compensate for the damage from critical hits
[*] Full set of  [b]“Firefighter”[/b] armor now grants bonus Force 
[*] Full set of [b]“Policeman”[/b] armor now grant bonus Aim 
[*] Full set of [b]“Military”[/b] armor now has 6% lesser penalty to movement speed
[/list]
[h3]Interface[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved ping display
[*] Fixed errors in the “Killer info” screen
[/list]
[h3]Map improvements and level design[/h3]
[list]
[*] Visual improvements for multiple areas of the map
[/list]
[h2]Nearest Future[/h2]
To emphasize the prestige and importance of getting kills, we will add an announcer, which will comment on multikills, the beginning of new phases, etc. We will also add a bonus to stats which can be earned through kill streaks. They will be applied to each player individually, until they get knocked down (not killed). For those familiar with league of Legends, you can think of it like bonus power from Mejai's Soulstealer — after getting 15 kills in a row in Dominance you will also get a juicy buff, but it will be followed closely by a high risk of losing this streak.

Thank you for your interest in Dominance and see you in the game, dominators!

[*] Adjusted projectile fly distance for next weapons: ak, slicegun, crossbow, laser, revolver
[/list]
[h3]Interface[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added display for available passive effects near the HP bar (Finn’s Dodge for example)
[*] Added display for team buffs and UI elements for them 
[*] Completed armor set will be highlighted in the UI
[*] Disabled ability to shoot or use abilities when there is less than 1 minute left before deployment
[*] Weapons tab is now available in the Main Menu
[/list]
[h3]In-game map improvements and level design[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added grass near trees
[*] Cosmetic improvements for in-game surroundings
[*] Added shadows to some objects
[*] Added highlighting for passageways
[/list] 
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Hunter’s description
[*] Fixed the bug which interrupted Consumables use
[*] Fixed the roof not disappearing when inside the Railway Station
[*] Disabled VR when launching the game from Steam
[*] Fixed chat and friend list windows display in lobbies
[*] Fixed the bug with clones of “Bumblebee” mob
[*] Fixed red circles appearing during Consumables use
[*] Fixed visuals for Finn’s Dodge ability (3rd perk) 
[*] Fixed laser disappearing when firing a weapon
[*] Fixed a bug where your item slot would blink when another player fires a weapon
[*] Fixed issues with switching to fullscreen mode after FPS setting change
[/list]
[h3]Critical errors[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash caused by playing video inside the client
[*] Fixed a crash caused by ADCharacterBase::ProcessSelfTeamChange() 
[*] Fixed a crash caused by ADConsumableEffect::UseSuccess_Implementation()
[*] Fixed a crash caused by ADFirearm::Reload_Implementation() 
[*] Fixed a crash caused by ADStoredInventory::CheckCooldown()
[*] Fixed a crash caused by ADInHandBase::ApplyDamageToCharacter() 
[/list]

Thank you for your interest in Dominance and see you in the game, dominators!

notes.title: Dominance — Second Playtest is here!
notes.content:
Greetings, Dominators!

It's time for the second big playtest for Dominance! [b]Starting Today and until Sunday, October 30th at 8:59 pm GMT[/b] you can once again join battlefields of Dominance — solo or with friends!

In this version of the game we have:
[list]
[*] Returned the hero Valkyrie 
[*] Unlocked 120 FPS
[*] Made balance changes and adjustments
[*] Fixed critical bugs
[/list]

[b]You can find the full Patch Notes below![/b] Let us know what you think of the game in Steam Discussions!
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2175780/discussions/][quote][h3]Leave Feedback[/h3][/quote][/url]

[h3]How to Play[/h3]
If you've [b]participated in previous playtest[/b], or at least got access and downloaded the game — just update Dominance and jump into the game!

If you're a new player — simply go to Dominance Steam page, click “Request Access”. After receiving confirmation press "Play the Game" to install the game’s client.

[b]There are no restriction on when or how long to play[/b] — simply launch the game any time you want and play as long as you want[b] until October 30rd at 8:59 pm GMT[/b]! If there are not enough players in the match — the game will add bots for you to play against.

[quote][h3]Current Playtest Schedule[/h3]
Today, October 29th — Sunday, October 30th, 8:59 pm GMT
Saturday, November 5th — Sunday, November 6th[/quote]

[h3]How to play with friends[/h3]
1. Open your Friend list and click “+Invites”
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43094954/23c5d67fb407a11aa26f89fe45038256a4c15fa8.png[/img]

2. Type in the nickname of the player you want to add. [b]IMPORTANT:[/b] Upon 1st launch the game will ask you to come up with a nickname — you have to write this nickname to add a friend and NOT his Steam nickname.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43094954/067958d27a5e26c193c9813c93ab0dbd83466e04.png[/img]

3. After your friend accepts the invitation, you can find him in your Friend list. Simply cick on his profile in the list and select “Invite to Party”
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43094954/8f283e553ffbe7bdeea385ded93fefac4ff9423f.png[/img]

4. Voila! Just click “Play” and you’ll be on the same team when the match begins. You can have up to 3 people playing on one team.

[h3]Where do I report a bug or leave feedback?[/h3]
You can leave any feedback or bug reports here, in you’d like to share!
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2175780/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url]! We would appreciate any and all ideas and feedback 

[h3]Error 002 - Server is not responding[/h3]
This error means that the game’s server is currently offline. While we do our best to make sure it works properly throughout the playtest — some hiccups can still occur. [b]If you’re met with this error upon entering the game — just try starting it again a couple minutes later.[/b]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]General changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] After revival the 1st gear slot now follows next selection priority:
1. Ranged weapons
2. Melee weapons
3. Healing items
4. Any other valid gear
In the past after revival you could have the 1st slot empty, which defaulted to using fists as weapon.
[*] Added control tips
[*] Added a tip about receiving extra information for gear by hovering over it.
[*] Updated visuals for the Shrine — now its glow depends on the amount of XP left.
[*] Updated knockdowns. Now the Shrine occupied by enemy team won't affect revival time. The Shrines now have more distinct visuals, showing their availability.
[*] Unlocked 120 FPS
[*] Changed notifications about killing mobs.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed characters getting stuck in the Worm's wall.
[*] Fixed the animations for consumables and AK alt.attack getting stuck.
[*] Fixed some effects having too many triangles for particles.
[*] Changed FOW of houses and collision for burning cars.
[*] Fixed character not being highlighted through some obstacles.
[*] Temporarily disabled the artifact, which caused a bug with stamina regeneration.
[*] Fixed client crash from ArmorShred.
[*] Fixed client crash 2 seconds after joining the pre-match and joining the lobby from a match .
[*] Fixed server crash from ADCharacterBase::StartUse().
[*] Fixed the crash from interacting with teammates info in UPTeamMate::GetUserID().
[*] Fixed the crash from UPTeamMatch::GetMatchStage(). 
[*] Fixed the crash during level streaming.
[/list]
[h3]Balance changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Movement speed diminishing returns formula adjusted further.[/b] This should make it slightly harder to reach insane amounts of real movement speed.
[*] [b]Certain weapons damage rescaled to hit less on low weapon levels and more on higher weapon levels.[/b] We have noticed that some weapons stood out and got affected by power creep once we introduced more damage increase (power) sources to the game - artifacts, character perks and map-zone bonuses. This lead to some weapons being extremely powerful in low level fights and this conflicts with our idea of "second chances" - it becomes too punishing. That is why we will be rescaling damage on AK, pistol, revolver, jackhammer, SMG, sniper and slicegun.
[*] [b]Police and military armor now give slightly more defense at early levels and less defense at max levels.[/b] This is done mostly for the same reason as the previous fix, but this time hitting on the most powerful armor sets, since lategame already provides a lot of defense options that need to be shifter into earlier stages.
[*] [b]Collision hitboxes increased for melee weapons.[/b] We have recently adjusted the way we work with hitboxes on melee and found out that the current state just doesn't grant enough reach. Playing around with veteran melee builds should be more satisfying from now on.
[*] [b]Starter HP and defense adjusted for some characters.[/b] Once again as stated previously - we want to add some of the power into early game. We will be increasing the base HP/shields of all characters by about 50-100 depending on the role. Also Hunter and Stalker will get a slight increase in base defense to smooth out their encounters in the early game.
[/list]

That’s it! Thank you for your interest in Dominance and see you in the game, dominators!
